description: This file declares the AudioRendererPcm class, which manages audio data transfer between decoder, sink, and pipeline, and handles playback timing for PCM audio in a media player context.

classes.name: AudioRendererPcm
classes.description: Manages PCM audio rendering, including buffering, timing, and interaction with decoder and sink, for media playback.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm
methods.description: Constructor initializing the PCM audio renderer with decoder, sink, and configuration parameters.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with error, prerolled, and ended callbacks.

methods.name: WriteSamples
methods.description: Feeds input audio buffers into the renderer.

methods.name: IsEndOfStreamWritten
methods.description: Checks if end of stream has been written.

methods.name: IsEndOfStreamPlayed
methods.description: Checks if end of stream has been played.

methods.name: CanAcceptMoreData
methods.description: Indicates if renderer can accept more input data.

methods.name: GetCurrentMediaTime
methods.description: Returns current media time and playback status.
